hooks.name: H1 Validate the category rebuild
hooks.description: fsis_categories.py reconstructs the FSIS Category 1/2/3/NA rating from raw samples, and every downstream result depends on it matching FSIS's own postings (currently 99.75% across 2,764 posted rows, zero false Category 3). Breaking it silently would invalidate the analysis without failing anything, so editing it re-runs the validation against all three posted windows immediately.
